success_policy.accuracy_definition: machine-verified propositions divided by registered propositions

recovery_policy.all_transport_failures: checkpoint_current_task; explicit restart opens a fresh five-attempt window and retains full history
recovery_policy.finalization_transport: after an unchanged whole candidate passes, finalization connection retries are separate from candidate rounds

summary.startup_excluded_time_definition: Language worker wall time minus directly measured initialization/loading of candidate sessions and independent final sessions. Model/API, retries and both actual verification stages remain included. Unknown historical final startup is never estimated.

verification_phases.label: Verifier phases only; end-to-end task wall time and provider token usage remain separate.
Verifier phases only; end-to-end task wall time and provider token usage remain separate.

summary.time_accounting: Batch elapsed is measured parent wall time. Worker/task intervals may overlap; do not add them to obtain wall time.
summary.interpretation: Primary accuracy follows the frozen success policy. In machine-verification mode, semantic annotations never block passing, publication or primary scoring. Unattempted registered propositions remain in the denominator; unknown usage remains unknown. Semantic accuracy is a separate optional metric.

verification_timing.note: Wall-clock phases. Warm candidate timing is native Session/REPL request-response time after seed/library loading; replay and startup are separate. Fresh-file timing includes process startup/imports. These are not CPU-only times. Failures remain included. Native events left outside a completed receipt by interruption/recovery are retained as unreceipted_native_seconds; model/network/orchestration is separate. Split final initialization and verification are measured in a new independent native Session/REPL. These detail fields are subsets of independent_final_file_seconds, not additional phases. Only total_initialization_seconds is subtracted from end-to-end time; candidate and final verification remain included.

retry_statistics.definition: One candidate incremental check per stable logical item; retries=max(0, attempts-1). Scope, cached checks, replay, final and submission gates are excluded. Unknown interrupted counts remain null.
